item.falsifier: Demonstration that episodic trace retention alone is sufficient to produce functionally identical behavior across structurally distinct agent instances.
item.reason: Advancing toward commitment commit-mem-id-01 by framing the theoretical distinction between continuity and identity as a prerequisite for metric definition.
item.statement: Episodic trace retention acts as a necessary but insufficient condition for persistent identity in computational agents, which further requires integrative regulatory invariants.
